## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(boot)
```

## #2 Set seed

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

## #3 Import Data

```{r}
data <- read.csv(here("results","drug_effects.csv"))
```

## #4 Choose Scenarios

```{r}
nint = 56
correlations_between_models = c(0.8, 0.9, 0.95)
correlation_LODO = c(0.53, 0.45)
```

## #5 Simulated Effect Data Function

```{r}
simulated_data <- function(corr_between_models=0.8, corr_LODO = 0.53, noise_mean = 0, noise_sd = 0.3) {

  cor_matrix <- matrix(
    c(
      1,   corr_LODO, 0.36,
      corr_LODO, 1,   corr_between_models,
      0.36, corr_between_models, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
  
  R <- chol(cor_matrix)
  Z <- matrix(rnorm(nint * 3), nrow = nint, ncol = 3)
  
  effects <- Z %*% R
  
  #Add Noise to Data
  noise1 = rnorm(nint, mean = noise_mean, sd = noise_sd)
  effects[,1] = effects[,1] + noise1

  return(effects)
}
```

## #6 Correlation Function

```{r}
corr <- function(df, met="pearson") {
  
  corr_c = cor(df$Lifespan, df$Clock_LODO, method = met)
  corr_m = cor(df$Lifespan, df$Clock_LOIO, method = met)
  
  delta_corr = corr_m - corr_c
  
  return (delta_corr)
}
```

## #7 Bootstrap Delta R Function

```{r}
delta_corr <- function(data, indices) {
  sample <- data[indices, ]
  
  RLODO <- cor(sample[, 1], sample[, 2])
  RLOIO <- cor(sample[, 1], sample[, 3])
  
  R=RLODO - RLOIO
  return(R)
}
```

## #8 Simulate 1000 Times

```{r}
results <- data.frame()

potencia <- data.frame(
  Intervention = paste0("Drug_", 1:nint),
  Lifespan = numeric(nint),
  Clock_LODO = numeric(nint),
  Clock_LOIO = numeric(nint)
)
for (cor in correlation_LODO){
  
  for (corr_value in correlations_between_models) {
    
    delta_corr_values <- numeric(1000)
    
    bootstrap_values <- vector("list", 1000)
    
    CI <- data.frame(
      p5 = numeric(1000),
      p95 = numeric(1000)
    )
    
    for (i in 1:1000) {
      effects <- simulated_data(corr_between_models = corr_value, corr_LODO = cor)
      df <- potencia
      df[, 2:4] <- effects
      delta_corr_values[i] <- corr(df)
      
      boot_results = boot(
        data = effects,
        statistic = delta_corr,
        R = 500
      )
      
      CI$p5[i] <- quantile(boot_results$t, probs = 0.05)
      CI$p95[i] <- quantile(boot_results$t, probs = 0.95)
    }
    
    LB_under_zero=sum(CI$p5 < 0)
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Scenario = scenario,
      nint = nint,
      corr_between_models = corr_value,
      Mean_corr_between_models = mean(delta_corr_values),
      Percentile_Range_CI95 =
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.975) -
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.025),
      Percentile_Range_CI90 =
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.95) -
        quantile(delta_corr_values, 0.05)
    ))
    
    cat("There are", LB_under_zero, "simulations with the lower bound below 0 for
        correlation_LODO =", cor," and correlations_between_models = ", corr_value, "\n")
  }
  
  results
  
}
```

## #9 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(results,
          here("results","potencia_results_corr_between_models.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
